column1: # Verbatim transcription of the official NWS hourly forecast for the KICKOFF HOUR of
# each Week 11 game whose venue has a published coordinate pair AND is an outdoor US
# (the grid is resolved by api.weather.gov/points/<lat>,<lon>, and the resolved grid is
# recorded per row so the coordinate is auditable).
# A venue absent from this file was NOT read and its row stays blank + flagged. It is
# never filled from memory or from a non-official provider.
# Kickoff for every Week 11 game is in the NWS period whose own startTime is given.
